[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Count Days Without Meetings** [LC 3169 · Count Days Without Meetings](https://leetcode.com/problems/count-days-without-meetings/){difficulty="Medium"}

The free days are the **gaps** of the union of the meetings inside $[1, \texttt{days}]$. Overlaps make counting meeting days directly wrong, but after a sort by start one walk with a running "covered up to here" day sees every gap exactly once: a meeting that starts after that day leaves the days in between free. The answer is the gap count, or equivalently $\texttt{days}$ minus the length of the merged union.

[Solved in full in @sec-int-p5-c.]{.card-link}

:::
